owner_authorization.quote: 可以那现在准备去训练吧  负样本应该用啥呢
owner_authorization.interpretation: Prepare a negative cohort for the accepted 8,000-image Grade-A positive set. This authorizes negative-dataset preparation and QA, but does not silently override the repository P0/P1 training gate, permit holdout access, or authorize promotion/production use.

single_variable: Replace the legacy 30,000-negative cohort with a nuisance-matched 24,000-negative cohort for the unchanged Grade-A 8,000 positive images and labels.

positive_source.contract: Copy every clean 1280x742 positive PNG and one-box label byte-for-byte; do not re-render, shift, resize, or redraw positives.

reasons: Legacy negatives are sourced from the old OKX-only domain while 6,809/8,000 Grade-A positives are Binance USD-M.
Only 3,834/30,000 legacy negatives use 18/19 bars; the new positives use only 18/19 bars.
Legacy pre/post geometry is pre 10-14 and post 4-6; the new positive variants span pre 5-12 and post 2-9.
Legacy guards protect the old 14,117-candidate universe, not the expanded Binance+OKX retrieval universe.

completed_no_launch_condition.purpose: Future bars define only the completed-history negative label; they never cross holdout and do not alter the rendered variant window.

hard_definition.meaning: Visually dense six-MA near miss whose completed path fails every launch threshold.

easy_definition.meaning: Clearly non-dense background that also satisfies the completed no-launch label.

positive_guard.okx_policy: Re-run the hash-pinned accepted-family strict scan on every used OKX source and guard every hit, not only the selected Grade-A events.

activity_gate.reason: Failed materialization attempt 1 found four post-settlement frozen-price negative events whose OHLC values were constant for the full dependency interval; 29 rows collapsed to two pixel hashes. Reject inactive flat windows before selection.

negative_sampling.capacity_policy: Never cross source, symbol, venue, half-year, split, core length or context geometry; never reuse/overlap a negative dependency interval; fail closed if two hard negatives cannot be found. Only the third easy slot may safely fall back to another hard negative.

split.method: Copy the positive event split and independently verify the widest negative render-plus-label dependency interval against the same chronological cutoff.

attempt_1.root_cause: Four easy negative events were sampled from post-settlement frozen-price spans with constant OHLC. Distinct context indices normalized to identical horizontal-line pixels.
attempt_1.single_remediation: Add the frozen minimum activity gate above and rebuild from a newly selected plan; keep all other thresholds, pairing, split and rendering contracts unchanged.
